strategiesDefined.name: OpenAI response_format JSON Schema
strategiesDefined.description: OpenAI-compatible response_format json_schema; skipped by the offline LLM worker when no loopback server path is enabled.

strategiesDefined.name: vLLM structured_outputs JSON
strategiesDefined.description: vLLM guided JSON schema via the installed runtime's SamplingParams support.

strategiesDefined.name: vLLM grammar
strategiesDefined.description: vLLM grammar-constrained JSON output if the installed runtime supports grammar guided decoding.

strategiesDefined.name: structural tag
strategiesDefined.description: Structural-tag JSON protocol; skipped by the offline LLM worker unless supported.

strategiesDefined.description: Deterministic wrapper/markdown extraction diagnostic; never counts as a Phase 39C-Q-SO pass.
